name: Faster-Qwen3-TTS-Wyoming
description: Local Faster Qwen3-TTS with a WebUI, an OpenAI-compatible streaming API, and an integrated Wyoming TTS adapter for Home Assistant. Both interfaces share one NVIDIA GPU model instance.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Persistent Hugging Face, Gradio, and Torch caches.

ports.name: Qwen WebUI and API Port
ports.description: Gradio WebUI and OpenAI-compatible TTS API.

ports.name: Wyoming TTS Port
ports.description: Wyoming protocol endpoint for Home Assistant.

variables.name: Qwen3-TTS Model
variables.description: Hugging Face model identifier. Use Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-CustomVoice for the default quality profile or Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-0.6B-CustomVoice for lower VRAM usage.

variables.name: Default Voice
variables.description: Default CustomVoice speaker. Supported: aiden, dylan, eric, ono_anna, ryan, serena, sohee, uncle_fu, vivian.

variables.name: Language
variables.description: Qwen synthesis language.

variables.name: Instruct
variables.value: Speak naturally, clearly, and warmly in English. Use a calm, fluent pace, lively but restrained prosody, and natural sentence pauses. Articulate sibilants and numbers clearly. Avoid monotonous intonation, exaggerated emotion, and dramatic pitch changes.
variables.description: Default instruction applied to TTS requests without their own instruction.

variables.name: Temperature
variables.description: Sampling temperature. Lower values are calmer and more stable.

variables.name: Top P
variables.description: Nucleus sampling probability.

variables.name: Top K
variables.description: Number of token candidates used during sampling.

variables.name: Repetition Penalty
variables.description: Penalty used to reduce repeated speech artifacts.

variables.name: Sampling Enabled
variables.description: Enable stochastic token sampling.

variables.name: Seed
variables.description: Default random seed for reproducible requests.

variables.name: Maximum New Tokens
variables.description: Upper generation limit per text segment.

variables.name: Non-Streaming Mode
variables.description: Keep false for incremental PCM generation.

variables.name: Streaming Chunk Size
variables.description: Model token chunk size used for streaming output.

variables.name: Token Safety Margin
variables.description: Multiplier used when estimating the segment token budget.

variables.name: Maximum Segment Characters
variables.description: Long text is split into bounded segments at natural boundaries.

variables.name: Segment Pause Milliseconds
variables.description: Silence inserted between long-text segments.

variables.name: Pending Queue Limit
variables.description: Maximum queued synthesis requests.

variables.name: Backend
variables.description: Faster Qwen3-TTS inference backend.

variables.name: Device
variables.description: Inference device. The default image is intended for CUDA.

variables.name: Torch DType
variables.description: Torch model dtype.

variables.name: Attention Implementation
variables.description: Torch attention implementation.

variables.name: GGML Quantization
variables.description: Quantization passed to the GGML backend.

variables.name: Force Language
variables.description: Always synthesize using the configured language.

variables.name: Startup Timeout Seconds
variables.description: Maximum first-start model download and initialization time.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: Host user ID used for appdata files.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Host group ID used for appdata files.

variables.name: UMASK
variables.description: File creation mask.

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Container timezone.

variables.name: NVIDIA Visible Devices
variables.description: NVIDIA GPU selection.

variables.name: NVIDIA Driver Capabilities
variables.description: Required NVIDIA driver capabilities.
